title: Hyperliquid instrument
description: One perp of the Hyperliquid catalogue (decision 0003 §2.5–2.6) as the adapter builds it from `perpDexs`, `meta` per dex and `spotMeta` (src/venues/hyperliquid/instruments.ts, HlInstrument). Extends the domain Instrument of src/domain/orders/validate.ts. Asset id: the universe index on the main dex, `100000 + 10000 × dexIndex + assetIndex` on a HIP-3 dex.

name.description: The venue's coin name, with the dex prefix on HIP-3 (`xyz:XYZ100`).

minNotional.description: Minimum order value in the collateral token, checked at the order's price and at the mark.

venueMarginMode.description: The venue's own marginMode string when it sends one (strictIsolated, noCross).

isDelisted.description: On HIP-3 it also means never activated.

collateralToken.description: Spot token index of the dex's collateral.
